findings.detail: The strict release resolves nine reviewed evidence references through the hash-bound question receipt.
Five additions have unique IDs and topics, equivalent FR/EN intent, valid domains and acyclic dependencies.
The proposal changes only five question notes under the governance questionnaire overlay; active vault, Canvas, indexes, taxonomy and sources remain unchanged.
The cited governance materials are not current-law evidence and are used for assessable governance controls only.
The exact candidate hash must be approved before deterministic integration.
